# Calendar — Evidence

<!-- Generated by `tyto-docs-engine build-evidence`. Do not edit. -->

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.c393c430"></a>**1. CalendarModule is a NestJS module that imports HttpModule and AuthModule, registers CalendarController as its controller, and provides and exports GoogleCalendarService and IcsService.**
  [`calendar.module.ts:8-13`](../calendar.module.ts#L8-L13)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.28d61066"></a>**2. IcsService.generateIcs produces a complete iCalendar 2.0 document with BEGIN:VCALENDAR, VERSION:2.0, PRODID:-//UP Schedule Generator//EN, CALSCALE:GREGORIAN, and METHOD:PUBLISH, containing one VEVENT per event joined by CRLF, and throws an Error when a recurring event lacks semester dates.**
  [`ics.service.ts:39-67`](../ics.service.ts#L39-L67)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.2b59ee2e"></a>**3. CalendarController is a NestJS controller mapped to the 'api' route prefix and tagged 'Calendar' in Swagger, and it depends on GoogleCalendarService, IcsService, AuthService, and ConfigService.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:34-42`](../calendar.controller.ts#L34-L42)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.bf5a6451"></a>**4. GoogleCalendarService is an injectable NestJS service that calls the Google Calendar v3 REST API at https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3 through HttpService, authenticating with the user's OAuth access token as a Bearer token.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:7-7`](../calendar.service.ts#L7-L7)
  [`calendar.service.ts:52-54`](../calendar.service.ts#L52-L54)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.eb000815"></a>**5. The calendar index.ts barrel re-exports CalendarModule, GoogleCalendarService, IcsService, and the DTO index.**
  [`index.ts:1-4`](../index.ts#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.f2fecd25"></a>**6. getAccessToken reads the access token from the request's session user via AuthService.getAccessToken and throws a 401 HttpException with the GOOGLE_AUTH_REQUIRED error code when the token is missing.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:315-328`](../calendar.controller.ts#L315-L328)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.d59aaf87"></a>**7. getCurrentSemesterInfo derives the current semester (S1 or S2) from the FIRST_SEMESTER_START, FIRST_SEMESTER_END, SECOND_SEMESTER_START, and SECOND_SEMESTER_END environment variables, returning the semester currently in progress, the next semester during a break, or null when any of the variables is unset.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:264-309`](../calendar.controller.ts#L264-L309)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.2dca828d"></a>**8. GoogleCalendarService.listCalendars fetches GET /users/me/calendarList with the access token and maps each returned item to a CalendarDto carrying id, summary, description, primary, and backgroundColor.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:61-84`](../calendar.service.ts#L61-L84)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.ff0005af"></a>**9. The GET api/calendars endpoint (listCalendars) returns the authenticated user's Google calendars as a CalendarListDto containing a calendars array.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:44-57`](../calendar.controller.ts#L44-L57)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.a993a83c"></a>**10. The POST api/calendars endpoint (createCalendar) creates a new Google Calendar from a CreateCalendarDto carrying a name and optional description, and returns the created CalendarDto.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:60-79`](../calendar.controller.ts#L60-L79)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.fa2d817c"></a>**11. The POST api/calendars/events endpoint (addEvents) adds parsed schedule events to a Google Calendar; when the payload contains recurring (lecture) events and semester dates are missing it derives them from the current semester and filters events to those matching the detected semester, throwing a 400 MISSING_SEMESTER_DATES HttpException when the semester cannot be determined automatically.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:81-170`](../calendar.controller.ts#L81-L170)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.884e28b4"></a>**12. The POST api/generate/ics endpoint (generateIcs) generates an ICS file from the supplied events, applying the same semester derivation and semester filtering as addEvents, and sends it as a text/calendar attachment named schedule.ics.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:172-259`](../calendar.controller.ts#L172-L259)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.803ee401"></a>**13. GoogleCalendarService.createCalendar creates a calendar via POST /calendars with the given name as the summary and an optional description, returning the created calendar as a CalendarDto.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:93-123`](../calendar.service.ts#L93-L123)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.441cec18"></a>**14. GoogleCalendarService.addEvents posts each event to POST /calendars/{calendarId}/events sequentially to avoid rate limiting, converting each EventConfigDto to Google Calendar event format first and delegating errors to handleGoogleApiError.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:134-166`](../calendar.service.ts#L134-L166)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.ded478de"></a>**15. convertToGoogleEvent routes recurring events to createRecurringGoogleEvent, throwing an Error when semester dates are missing, and routes non-recurring events to createSingleGoogleEvent.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:171-183`](../calendar.service.ts#L171-L183)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.2e7a14c2"></a>**16. createRecurringGoogleEvent builds a weekly recurring Google Calendar event with an RRULE of FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=<day code>;UNTIL=<semester end>, local dateTime values and the Africa/Johannesburg timezone, starting on the first occurrence of the event's weekday on or after the semester start.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:188-220`](../calendar.service.ts#L188-L220)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.445c10fa"></a>**17. createSingleGoogleEvent builds a one-time Google Calendar event from the event's date and start/end times with the Africa/Johannesburg timezone, adding the event's notes as the description when present.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:226-257`](../calendar.service.ts#L226-L257)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.441f9b4d"></a>**18. toLocalISOString formats a Date as a local ISO string without UTC conversion, because the Google Calendar API expects local time when a timeZone is specified and toISOString() would introduce timezone offset issues.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:259-267`](../calendar.service.ts#L259-L267)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.8674fc85"></a>**19. getFirstOccurrence computes the first occurrence of a recurring event as the first date on or after the semester start that falls on the event's weekday, defaulting to Monday when the day name is not recognised.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:272-281`](../calendar.service.ts#L272-L281)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.195d974f"></a>**20. handleGoogleApiError converts Google API errors into HttpExceptions carrying the CALENDAR_API_ERROR error code, using the response status when present (a 401 maps to 'Google authentication expired. Please re-authenticate.') and falling back to 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.**
  [`calendar.service.ts:286-313`](../calendar.service.ts#L286-L313)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.1b1f83ae"></a>**21. IcsService.createRecurringEvent emits a VEVENT with a UID of <event id>@upschedulegen, DTSTAMP, DTSTART and DTEND, an RRULE of FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=<day code>;UNTIL=<semester end date>, and escaped SUMMARY and LOCATION lines.**
  [`ics.service.ts:77-99`](../ics.service.ts#L77-L99)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.0209c422"></a>**22. IcsService.createSingleEvent emits a one-time VEVENT without an RRULE, adding a DESCRIPTION line from the event's notes when present.**
  [`ics.service.ts:106-129`](../ics.service.ts#L106-L129)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.a1449049"></a>**23. IcsService.formatDateTime formats a date and an HH:MM time as a local YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS string for iCalendar DTSTART and DTEND values.**
  [`ics.service.ts:154-162`](../ics.service.ts#L154-L162)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.bc3e9708"></a>**24. IcsService.formatDateOnly formats an ISO date string as a YYYYMMDD date for the RRULE UNTIL value.**
  [`ics.service.ts:169-175`](../ics.service.ts#L169-L175)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.cddcfa48"></a>**25. IcsService.formatNow formats the current UTC time as a YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ string for the DTSTAMP value.**
  [`ics.service.ts:181-190`](../ics.service.ts#L181-L190)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar.913fffb6"></a>**26. IcsService.escapeText escapes backslashes, semicolons, commas, and newlines in text so it is safe for ICS fields.**
  [`ics.service.ts:197-203`](../ics.service.ts#L197-L203)
